Native edges/corners and 2x2/4x4 review: no obvious extra thick perimeter, doubled grout or large discontinuous boundary color patch at the inspected scales.
All endpoint RGB differences nonzero; stone TB MAE40.484 crosses a normal grout line and is not proof of a visual break or proof of seamlessness.
Terracotta course heights vary slightly; initial exact8course/4x4block prompt counts not all met. Basket weave approximately6x6blocks; selected terracotta edit permits changed course count.
Low-frequency material-color/mineral-grain repetition is visible in 4x4; actual scene UV scale remains to be evaluated.
Small pores, edge wear and slight edge light/dark detail remain; no large directional cast shadow or neon coloration observed.
Actual market warm lights shift sage stone and sandstone toward orange-brown; identity remains in their distinct paving structures.
